newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Olympia says gaming licence renewed.
newsitem.headline: Olympia says gaming licence renewed.

text.p: Malaysian gaming firm Olympia Industries Bhd said on Tuesday that its gaming licence in eastern Sabah state has been renewed by the Ministry of Finance, with effect from January 1, 1997.
In a statement, Olympia said it also requested trading in its stock remain suspended pending announcement of "a proposed acquisition".
Olympia did not give details of the acquisition.
Olympia, which is 54.7 percent owned by Mycom Bhd, had its gaming licence revoked by the ministry in January last year. The government, however, did not say why the licence was revoked.
Olympia had appealed against the decision.
The company reported a 35 percent decline in net earnings for the year ended June 30, 1996 to 44.78 million ringgit, which it said was partially due to the loss of the gaming licence.
Shares of Olympia, which were suspended on Monday, were last traded at 2.21 ringgit.
